title: Build an Etsy listing with AI, real photos, and a search check
summary: Use ChatGPT or Claude to draft from verified facts, annotate real photos in Canva, configure Etsy accurately, and check search terms with eRank or Etsy Stats. Includes a complete pouch example and a downloadable working kit.
releaseChecks: All measurements, material and care claims have evidence.
The required original real-background photo remains unedited.
First image shows the finished customized sample.
The actual item, labels, alt text and ordering controls agree.
Personalization, stock, price and fulfillment are checked in Etsy.
No invented keyword demand, testing claims or sales results.
Post-publication display checked and changes logged.

policyFindings.claim: Most products require an unedited actual-item photograph against a real background. Keep it separate from Canva edits.
For seller-made customized items, first-image guidance requires a finished customized item rather than placeholder text.
Current title guidance suggests fewer than 15 words; technical title limit remains 140 characters.
Tags allow 13 slots and 20 characters each.
Current variation guidance supports up to 3 attribute variations; price is the full variant price.

documentationConflicts.observed: The create-a-listing guide states 20 photos and 2 videos; the variation article retains 10 photos in its photo-linking steps.
documentationConflicts.editorialDecision: The guide uses seven purposeful images and does not hardcode maximum upload capacity.

assets.captionBasis: Vendor-published instructional illustration; no claimed live account test.
Genuine vendor documentation screenshot of country selector; contains no pouch metrics.

preservation: Original synthetic POUCH-01 input and full example output copied without modification.
instructionBasis: Vendor documentation verified; worked example, prompts and trial checks are editorial illustrations. No firsthand seller-account testing or keyword-demand research is claimed.
